guide: Open Start and type your agency name and your payroll settings in the yellow cells: the overtime line (40 hours a week), the overtime multiplier, the holiday multipliers, payroll burden, mileage rate and your cost ceiling.
Check Caregivers, Pay Rate Card and Team. A caregiver is also called a carer, care worker or support worker. A one-person agency can use only Pay Run Lines, Pay Periods and Holidays.

Each pay run, add one row per caregiver on Pay Run Lines. Gross pay, net pay, payroll burden (payroll taxes, workers insurance and benefits on top of pay) and cost per hour fill in by themselves. Confirm pay rules with your adviser.
Enter time sheets on Time Sheet Approvals with the hours from check-ins typed or pasted from whatever you use. The workbook compares them; it has no app, no GPS and no automatic check-in.
On Monday, use Pre-payroll Check and Pre-payroll Warnings: fix missing check-outs, negative net pay and mismatches before the pay run. Pay Periods shows hours paid against hours billed.

On Wednesday, update Overtime Forecast and look at This and Next Week Visits. Overtime means hours above the weekly line. Midweek Overtime Forecast and Move Visit to Avoid Overtime say which visit to give to whom.

Use Holidays, Holiday Margin Forecast and Holiday Premium Choice before every holiday. Holiday rate means the extra pay and charge on a bank holiday; Holiday Pay History shows what past holidays cost.
Record Bonuses and Deductions, Pay Rate Changes, Travel and Mileage Pay and Payroll Burden by Month so every pay line has a reason you can show. Use miles and your own rate if you prefer.
Read Payroll Cost Ratio and the Payroll KPI Dashboard every month: pay cost against revenue and your ceiling, overtime share, warnings and time sheets.
Use the 18 decision tools: each ends with a verdict and a what-if table. Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready messages.

Why a workbook: one flat price, no per-caregiver or per-client fee, no price rise when hours grow, and your data stays in your own file. It prepares numbers for your payroll service or adviser and gives no legal or employment-status advice.

listing.title: Home Care Agency Payroll Excel Template: Overtime Forecast, Pay Run, Holiday Pay, Mileage, Cost Ceiling, KPI Dashboard
listing.headline: Prepare the pay run, see overtime before it happens, in one Excel file
listing.description:
Prepare caregiver payroll in one Excel workbook, built for a small non-medical home care agency run by an owner-director with a scheduler, an office manager and about 40 caregivers. A one-person start-up agency can use Pay Run Lines, Pay Periods and Holidays on their own.

Pay Run Lines show regular, overtime, holiday, paid travel, mileage, cover premium, bonus and deductions per caregiver and pay period, with gross pay, net pay, payroll burden, total cost and cost per worked hour calculated. Pre-payroll Warnings and Time Sheet Approvals compare hours entered with hours from check-ins and list overtime near the line, missing check-outs and negative net pay before pay day. Overtime Forecast and This and Next Week Visits show who crosses your overtime line this week, and Overtime Moves suggest which visit to give to whom. Holidays, Holiday Pay History, Pay Rate Card, Pay Rate Changes, Travel and Mileage Pay, Payroll Burden by Month, Overtime by Month and Payroll Cost Ratio keep every pay rule visible and checked against your own ceiling.

18 decision tools answer weekly questions with a verdict and a what-if table: payroll line calculator, pre-payroll check, midweek overtime forecast, move this visit, overtime rule test, payroll cost per hour, cost ceiling, burden check, holiday margin, premium choice, paid travel policy, pay run funding check and more. Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready messages.

This is part four of the Home Care Agency Business suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros, one flat price with no per-caregiver fee, your data stays with you, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data. It prepares numbers for a payroll service or an adviser and gives no legal, tax or employment advice: confirm every pay and tax cell with your adviser. It has no live app, no GPS and no automatic check-in.

documents.title: Pay statement for one caregiver and pay run
paragraphs: Pay statement of {set:company}, dated {today}. Caregiver: {col:payrun.caregiver} ({col:payrun.employment}). Pay period {col:payrun.period_start} to {col:payrun.period_end}, paid on {col:payrun.pay_date}.

Hours: regular {col:payrun.regular_hours}, overtime {col:payrun.overtime_hours} (hours above {set:overtime_hours} a week), holiday {col:payrun.holiday_hours}, paid travel {col:payrun.travel_hours}. Distance: {col:payrun.distance_km} km.

Pay: regular pay {col:payrun.regular_pay}, overtime pay {col:payrun.overtime_pay}, holiday premium {col:payrun.holiday_premium}, travel pay {col:payrun.travel_pay}, mileage {col:payrun.mileage_pay}, cover premium {col:payrun.cover_premium}, bonus {col:payrun.bonus}.
Gross pay {col:payrun.gross_pay}. Deductions {col:payrun.deductions}. Net pay {col:payrun.net_pay}.

These figures are prepared for the payroll service. Taxes and other deductions that your local rules require are handled there: confirm with your adviser. If something looks wrong, tell the office within 7 days.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own agency and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Pay run summary for the payroll service
paragraphs: Pay run summary of {set:company}, dated {today}, for the payroll service. Pay period {col:payperiods.period_start} to {col:payperiods.period_end}, pay date {col:payperiods.pay_date}. Status: {col:payperiods.status}.
Caregivers paid: {col:payperiods.caregivers_paid}. Paid hours: {col:payperiods.hours}. Hours billed to clients: {col:payperiods.billed_hours}. Paid minus billed hours: {col:payperiods.hours_gap}.

Total cost with burden: {col:payperiods.total_cost}, or {col:payperiods.cost_per_hour} per paid hour. Travel pay {col:payperiods.travel_pay}, mileage {col:payperiods.mileage_amount}, cover premium {col:payperiods.cover_premium}.

Open pre-payroll warnings: {col:payperiods.open_warnings}. Please approve by {col:payperiods.approve_by}. The pay lines are attached in the pay run file; confirm taxes and deductions with your adviser.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own agency and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Overtime report for one month
paragraphs: Overtime report of {set:company}, dated {today}. Month: {col:otmonth.month}.

Paid hours: {col:otmonth.hours}. Overtime hours: {col:otmonth.overtime_hours} by {col:otmonth.caregivers_ot} caregivers. Overtime pay: {col:otmonth.overtime_pay}, or {col:otmonth.pay_per_hour} per overtime hour.
Overtime share of paid hours: {col:otmonth.overtime_share}. Target: {set:overtime_share_target}. Check: {col:otmonth.share_check}.
Decisions for the scheduler: which visits to move, which caregivers to cover for, and whether the overtime line of {set:overtime_hours} hours still suits the agency.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own agency and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Holiday pay notice to caregivers
paragraphs: Holiday pay notice of {set:company}, dated {today}. Dear team,

On {col:holidays.date} ({col:holidays.weekday}) it is {col:holidays.holiday}. Visits on that day are paid at {col:holidays.pay_mult} times your normal pay rate (the holiday rate, also called a bank holiday rate).
We expect {col:holidays.visits_booked} visits and {col:holidays.hours_booked} hours, so we need about {col:holidays.caregivers_needed} caregivers. Please tell the scheduler if you can work.
Your pay statement will show the holiday premium on its own line. If you have questions, call the office. Check your own local rules for anything not covered here.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own agency and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Pay rate change letter
paragraphs: Pay rate change letter of {set:company}, dated {today}. Dear {col:raises.caregiver},

From {col:raises.date} your pay rate changes from {col:raises.old_rate} to {col:raises.new_rate} per hour, a rise of {col:raises.rise_amount} per hour ({col:raises.rise_share}). Reason: {col:raises.reason}.
The new rate applies to hours worked from that date. Overtime and holiday pay use the new rate. This letter does not change any other term of your contract; confirm contract terms with your adviser.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own agency and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Bonus letter
paragraphs: Bonus letter of {set:company}, dated {today}. Dear {col:adjust.caregiver},
Thank you. We are pleased to pay you a bonus of {col:adjust.amount} ({col:adjust.kind}) with your pay on {col:adjust.pay_date}. Reason: {col:adjust.reason}.
Approved by {col:adjust.approved_by}. Taxes on a bonus are handled by the payroll service; confirm with your adviser.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own agency and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Mileage statement for one caregiver and period
paragraphs: Mileage statement of {set:company}, dated {today}. Caregiver: {col:travelpay.caregiver}. Period {col:travelpay.period_start} to {col:travelpay.period_end}.

Paid travel time between visits: {col:travelpay.travel_hours} hours, paid {col:travelpay.travel_pay}. Distance driven: {col:travelpay.distance_km} km at {set:mileage_rate} per km, paid {col:travelpay.mileage_amount}.
All-in travel pay per km: {col:travelpay.pay_per_km}. Please report any trip that is missing. If you prefer miles, use your own rate per mile.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own agency and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Payroll cost report for one month
paragraphs: Payroll cost report of {set:company}, dated {today}. Month: {col:payratio.month}.

Revenue {col:payratio.revenue} from {col:payratio.billed_hours} billed hours. Caregiver pay {col:payratio.caregiver_pay}, overtime pay {col:payratio.overtime_pay}, travel and mileage {col:payratio.travel_mileage}, payroll burden {col:payratio.burden}.

Total pay cost {col:payratio.total_pay_cost}, or {col:payratio.cost_per_hour} per billed hour. Ratio to revenue: {col:payratio.ratio}. Ceiling: {set:payroll_ratio_ceiling}. Check: {col:payratio.ceiling_check}. Room under the ceiling: {col:payratio.room}.
Actions for the owner and the office manager are written below.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own agency and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Pre-payroll warning list for one pay period
paragraphs: Pre-payroll warning list of {set:company}, dated {today}. Pay period {col:payperiods.period_start} to {col:payperiods.period_end}, pay date {col:payperiods.pay_date}.
Open warnings: {col:payperiods.open_warnings}. Paid hours {col:payperiods.hours} against {col:payperiods.billed_hours} billed (difference {col:payperiods.hours_gap}).

Write each open warning below with the caregiver, the kind (overtime near the line, missing check-out, negative net pay, hours mismatch, missing time sheet, rate not set) and who fixes it by {col:payperiods.approve_by}.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own agency and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Holiday rates notice to clients
paragraphs: Holiday rates notice of {set:company}, dated {today}. Dear client,

Visits on {col:holidays.date} ({col:holidays.holiday}) are charged at {col:holidays.bill_mult} times the normal rate for the time band. This is the holiday rate and it is written in your service agreement.
If you want to move a visit to another day, please tell us as early as you can. Rates are before any tax. We will confirm your visit times in advance.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own agency and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Payroll correction note for one time sheet
paragraphs: Payroll correction note of {set:company}, dated {today}. Caregiver: {col:timesheets.caregiver}. Pay period {col:timesheets.period_start} to {col:timesheets.period_end}.

Hours entered on the time sheet: {col:timesheets.hours_entered}. Hours from check-ins: {col:timesheets.hours_checkins}. Difference: {col:timesheets.difference} hours. Check: {col:timesheets.mismatch}.
Corrected hours to pay: ____________. The correction is paid in the next pay run. Approved by {col:timesheets.approved_by} on {col:timesheets.approved_on}. Approval status: {col:timesheets.approval}.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own agency and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Year-end pay summary line for the accountant
paragraphs: Pay summary for the accountant from {set:company}, dated {today}. Month: {col:burden.month}. Use one copy per month and add the months up for the year.

Pay base: {col:burden.pay_base}. Payroll taxes {col:burden.payroll_taxes}, workers insurance {col:burden.workers_insurance}, benefits {col:burden.benefits}. Total burden {col:burden.total_burden}, which is {col:burden.burden_share} of the pay base.
This is an example split prepared from the pay runs. Confirm every figure and the rules for your own area with your adviser.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own agency and check your own local rules.
